ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged $250 million fraud scheme involving Feeding Our Future and the misuse of federal funds meant for a food program
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to uncover the extent of the fraud scheme and identify potential co-conspirators
questions: How did the alleged leader of Feeding Our Future manage to misuse $250 million in federal funds?
Who else may be involved in the fraud scheme?
ideas.insight: The alleged fraud scheme involving Feeding Our Future has the potential to be one of the largest cases of its kind in Minnesota. By following the money trail, we may be able to uncover the extent of the scheme and identify potential co-conspirators
